summary: iter-131 SuperAdmin sweep + Blog fixes — 15/15 backend pytest green; frontend E2E: Blog public header on list+detail, back button, RTE sticky/scrollable, Create Admin OTP modal, Force-Delete buttons, Payments recon toggle+note modal, Renewals cards+table all verified working.

issues: Logo click stays on /blog URL though landing content renders — SPA-only navigation, not a bug but router history is not updated
Last column header truncated to 'Do' (likely 'Do' from 'Do…' visually cut). Widen the column or shorten label.
Modal has both 'Mark as reconciled' checkbox AND separate outer toggle — mildly redundant; consider unifying.

action_items: Nothing critical. Optional: widen 'Do' column in renewal-requests-table so its header text is not clipped.
critical_code_review_comments: super_admin.py is now 1867 lines — approaching an unwieldy size. Consider splitting into super_admin_admins.py / super_admin_billing.py / super_admin_delete_flows.py for maintainability.

Admin-create OTP endpoint returns fallback_code in the JSON body when Resend fails — fine for preview, but ensure production RESEND_API_KEY is valid or add a feature flag so the code is never exposed to the UI in prod.
reconcile_payment sets reconciled_by=''/reconciled_at='' when unmarking; better to use MongoDB $unset or store None so audit history isn't lost. Current behaviour is OK for MVP but not ideal.
The frontend requests full recon-toggle/recon-note testids per row (13 rows currently) — no pagination. When >1000 payments exist this will render slowly. Add pagination + server-side filter.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST admin (test_otp_<hex>@example.com) with a service reference + one unpaid invoice + one recorded+reconciled payment. Test class autouse fixture attempts DELETE cleanup at end (best-effort, may leave orphaned invoice/payment/service_reference/service_reference). Safe to purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration131_superadmin_sweep.py assert both status + payload. Key flows: (1) admin-create requires email_verification_token — token is single-use / burnt after create; (2) toggle-active correct URL is /toggle-active (not /toggle); (3) consented delete recipient == userAdmin's own email, forced delete == ceo@flowralive.in; (4) payments require an existing unpaid invoice unless allow_unlinked=true; (5) invoice requires service_reference from /super-admin/service-references; (6) reconcile toggle takes {reconciled:bool, note:str}. Frontend: PublicSiteHeader is a shared component used by Blog list + detail; the tab BUTTONS themselves don't have data-testid (only the rendered CONTENT div does — e.g. data-testid="payments-tab" is on the div rendered when Payments is selected). Click by text label to switch tabs.
